regions.name: Northern and Southeastern areas
regions.where: The unimodal north and centre (Greater Upper Nile, Greater Bahr el Ghazal, Lakes, Abyei) and the south-east (Pibor and Greater Kapoeta); no locator map is drawn, so the extent is inferred from the title and lean-season labels

lean.name: Pastoral Lean Season: Pibor and Greater Kapoeta

regions.notes: Main Harvest drawn as Sep-Dec plus Jan (one wrapping season). Planting begins in May, before the shaded rainy season (Jun-Sep). The pastoral lean season applies only to Pibor and Greater Kapoeta.

regions.name: Southwestern areas
regions.where: The bimodal Greenbelt of the south-west: Western Equatoria, Central Equatoria and the Magwi/Torit/Ikotos part of Eastern Equatoria (no locator map is drawn; inferred from the title)
regions.notes: Second Rainy Season ends exactly at mid-November (counted). Season 2 harvest drawn as Oct-Dec plus an unlabelled Jan bar (one wrapping season).

assign.method: No locator maps on this calendar: the Equatorias' bimodal Greenbelt counties went to southwestern, everything else (including Pibor and Greater Kapoeta, named in the lean labels) to northern-southeastern, using geographic knowledge.

transcriber_notes: This calendar has no locator maps, so the region extents and the adm1/adm2 assignment rest on the block titles, the lean-season labels (Pibor, Greater Kapoeta) and general knowledge of South Sudan's unimodal/bimodal split. Terekeka (Central Equatoria) is put with the unimodal north; Magwi, Torit and Ikotos (Eastern Equatoria) with the southwest.
